source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/agent_progress_probe/results/llm_judge_full_zeroshot.json'))
results = d['results']
n = len(results)
correct = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label'] == r['predicted_label'])
tp = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==1 and r['predicted_label']==1)
fp = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==0 and r['predicted_label']==1)
fn = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==1 and r['predicted_label']==0)
tn = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==0 and r['predicted_label']==0)
prec_p = tp/(tp+fp) if tp+fp else 0
rec_p = tp/(tp+fn) if tp+fn else 0
f1_p = 2*prec_p*rec_p/(prec_p+rec_p) if prec_p+rec_p else 0
prec_n = tn/(tn+fn) if tn+fn else 0
rec_n = tn/(tn+fp) if tn+fp else 0
f1_n = 2*prec_n*rec_n/(prec_n+rec_n) if prec_n+rec_n else 0
macro_f1 = (f1_p + f1_n) / 2
print(f'n_windows={d[\"n_windows\"]}, n_results={n}')
print(f'accuracy={correct/n:.4f} ({correct}/{n})')
print(f'TP={tp} FP={fp} FN={fn} TN={tn}')
print(f'progress_prec={prec_p:.4f} progress_rec={rec_p:.4f} progress_f1={f1_p:.4f}')
print(f'stagnation_prec={prec_n:.4f} stagnation_rec={rec_n:.4f} stagnation_f1={f1_n:.4f}')
print(f'macro_f1={macro_f1:.4f}')
print(f'cost=\${d[\"est_cost_usd\"]:.2f}')
print(f'model={d[\"model\"]}')

# label distribution
n_pos = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==1)
n_neg = sum(1 for r in results if r['true_label']==0)
print(f'label_dist: progress={n_pos} stagnation={n_neg}')
"
